verdict.rationale: Factory supports background automation via droid exec (one-shot, non-interactive runs for CI/CD pipelines and batch jobs) with tiered autonomy controlling unattended operations, plus a Sessions API to programmatically create and drive droid sessions and Missions for larger autonomous multi-step orchestration. Missing for 10: explicit scheduling/trigger mechanisms (e.g., cron-like recurring automations) and independent/hands-on confirmation that exec runs are reliably unattended in production.
